ruleEn: Use 은/는 to introduce a topic or contrast two things. Use 이/가 for new information, adjectives, and with 있어요/없어요.
ruleEs: Usa 은/는 para presentar un tema o contrastar. Usa 이/가 para información nueva, adjetivos y con 있어요/없어요.
exampleEn: As for Seoul, prices are a bit expensive.
exampleEs: En cuanto a Seúl, los precios son un poco caros.

titleEs: Objeto Directo y Lugar de Acción
formulaEn: Object: 을/를 · Destination/Static: 에 · Action at place: 에서
formulaEs: Objeto: 을/를 · Destino/Estar: 에 · Acción en lugar: 에서
ruleEn: Attach 을/를 to the object of an action. Use 에 for destinations (가요) and static existence (있어요), and 에서 when doing an action inside a place.
ruleEs: Añade 을/를 al objeto directo. Usa 에 para destinos (가요) y ubicación estática (있어요), y 에서 cuando haces una acción en ese lugar.
exampleEn: I drink coffee at a cafe.

formulaEn: ㅏ/ㅗ stem + 아요 · Other + 어요 · 하다 → 해요
formulaEs: Raíz ㅏ/ㅗ + 아요 · Otras + 어요 · 하다 → 해요
ruleEn: Drop 다 from any verb or adjective. Add 아요 if the last vowel is ㅏ or ㅗ, 어요 for all others, and change every 하다 to 해요.
ruleEs: Quita 다 al verbo o adjetivo. Añade 아요 si la vocal es ㅏ u ㅗ, 어요 para las demás, y cambia todo 하다 a 해요.
quizPromptEn: How do you conjugate 먹다 (to eat) into polite present?

formulaEn: Past: Present + ㅆ어요 · Future: Stem + (으)ㄹ 거예요
formulaEs: Pasado: Presente + ㅆ어요 · Futuro: Raíz + (으)ㄹ 거예요
ruleEn: Insert ㅆ under the present syllable for Past Tense (가요 → 갔어요). Attach ㄹ 거예요 (vowel) or 을 거예요 (consonant) for Future plans.
ruleEs: Añade ㅆ bajo la sílaba presente para Pasado (가요 → 갔어요). Usa ㄹ 거예요 (vocal) o 을 거예요 (consonante) para planes futuros.
exampleKr: 어제 홍대에 갔어요. 내일 서울에 갈 거예요.
exampleRom: Eo-je hong-dae-e ga-sseo-yo. Nae-il seo-u-re gal geo-ye-yo.
exampleEn: Yesterday I went to Hongdae. Tomorrow I will go to Seoul.
exampleEs: Ayer fui a Hongdae. Mañana iré a Seúl.
quizPromptEn: How do you say 'Tomorrow I will eat bibimbap'?

formulaEn: Want: Stem + 고 싶어요 · Can: Stem + (으)ㄹ 수 있어요/없어요
formulaEs: Querer: Raíz + 고 싶어요 · Poder: Raíz + (으)ㄹ 수 있어요/없어요
ruleEn: Attach -고 싶어요 directly to any verb stem to express desire. Use -(으)ㄹ 수 있어요 for ability ('can') and 없어요 for 'cannot'.
ruleEs: Añade -고 싶어요 a cualquier raíz verbal para expresar deseo. Usa -(으)ㄹ 수 있어요 para 'puedo' y 없어요 para 'no puedo'.
exampleKr: 한국에 가고 싶어요. 한국어를 할 수 있어요.
exampleRom: Han-gu-ge ga-go si-peo-yo. Han-gu-geo-reul hal su i-sseo-yo.
exampleEn: I want to go to Korea. I can speak Korean.
exampleEs: Quiero ir a Corea. Puedo hablar coreano.
quizPromptEn: How do you politely ask 'Can I take a photo?'
quizPromptEs: ¿Cómo preguntas con cortesía '¿Puedo tomar una foto?'

formulaEn: Please do for me: -아/어 주세요 · Please do: -(으)세요
formulaEs: Por favor haz por mí: -아/어 주세요 · Por favor: -(으)세요
ruleEn: Use -아/어 주세요 when asking someone to do something for you (like ordering food). Use -(으)세요 for polite invitations or instructions.
ruleEs: Usa -아/어 주세요 para pedir un favor o pedir comida. Usa -(으)세요 para invitaciones o indicaciones corteses.
quizPromptEn: How do you ask 'Please take a photo for me'?

formulaEn: But: Stem + 지만 · Because/So: Stem + 아/어서
formulaEs: Pero: Raíz + 지만 · Porque/Así que: Raíz + 아/어서
ruleEn: Attach -지만 to contrast two clauses ('but'). Attach -아/어서 to express cause and effect ('because / so'). Never put past tense before -아/어서!
ruleEs: Añade -지만 para contrastar ('pero'). Añade -아/어서 para causa y efecto ('porque'). Nunca pongas pasado antes de -아/어서.

formulaEn: -ing: Stem + 고 있어요 · Have tried: Stem + 아/어 봤어요
formulaEs: Estar -ndo: Raíz + 고 있어요 · Haber probado: Raíz + 아/어 봤어요
ruleEn: Use -고 있어요 for actions happening right now ('am doing'). Use -아/어 봤어요 to talk about life experiences ('have tried / have been to').
ruleEs: Usa -고 있어요 para acciones en progreso. Usa -아/어 봤어요 para experiencias ('he probado / he ido').
exampleKr: 지금 서울을 여행하고 있어요. 김치를 먹어 봤어요.
exampleRom: Ji-geum seo-u-reul yeo-haeng-ha-go i-sseo-yo. Gim-chi-reul meo-geo bwa-sseo-yo.
exampleEn: I am traveling in Seoul right now. I have tried kimchi.
exampleEs: Estoy viajando por Seúl ahora. He probado el kimchi.
quizPromptEn: How do you say 'Have you ever been to Jeju Island?'
quizPromptEs: ¿Cómo dices '¿Alguna vez has ido a la isla de Jeju?'

formulaEn: If: Stem + (으)면 · In order to: Stem + (으)려고
ruleEn: Use -(으)면 for conditions ('if / when'). Use -(으)려고 to state the purpose or intention behind an action ('in order to').
ruleEs: Usa -(으)면 para condiciones ('si / cuando'). Usa -(으)려고 para indicar el propósito o intención ('para').
exampleEn: If I have time, I plan to go to Seoul.
exampleEs: Si tengo tiempo, planeo ir a Seúl.
quizPromptEn: Which means 'I study Korean in order to travel to Korea'?
quizPromptEs: ¿Cuál significa 'Estudio coreano para viajar a Corea'?

ruleEn: Always use 존댓말 (-아/어요) with strangers, staff, and older people. Only drop 요 (반말) with close friends of the same age or younger.
ruleEs: Usa siempre 존댓말 (-아/어요) con desconocidos o mayores. Quita 요 (반말) solo con amigos muy cercanos de tu edad o menores.
